scope: Audit transport only. No production renderer, plugin, canonical comparison, frozen capture or attribution change.

design.format: Unchanged format v1: gzip of ordinary canonical JSON. No deduplication, sampling, schema replacement or framed transport.
design.encoding: Serialize the plain audit graph in native property/array order, batching UTF-8 tokens before streaming compression. No aggregate container JSON string is created.
design.checking: Regenerate the expected canonical bytes and compare every decompressed byte in order, plus exact compressed/uncompressed lengths and SHA-256 hashes. No aggregate decoded string or second parser is needed.
design.supportedInput: Plain JSON data graphs, with native omission/null-slot and nonfinite-number serialization semantics. Cycles, custom objects, accessors, callable toJSON and BigInt are rejected explicitly. This is not a replacement for JSON.stringify on arbitrary executable objects.
design.remainingMemory: The report object and compressed payload remain resident. Chunk/token buffering is bounded by the batching size and largest encoded leaf, plus traversal keys/ancestors. The legacy convenience decoder still requires a single bounded JSON string; the streaming verifier does not reconstruct a second report object.

controls: Native serialization equality across Unicode/chunk boundaries, integer-like keys, __proto__ data, sparse arrays, repeated references and nonfinite numbers.
Deterministic gzip and manifest equality with legacy encoder; legacy decoder acceptance for small documents.
Forced aggregate-object stringifier failure rejects the legacy encoder; streamed encoder and exact-byte verifier pass without invoking it.
First/middle/last nested changes, reordered/missing/extra observations rejected despite unchanged summaries.
Unsafe manifest fields, wrong lengths/hashes, corrupt/truncated gzip, invalid UTF-8/JSON, duplicate fields, extra document, whitespace, BOM and missing final newline rejected.
No mutation of source input; unsupported executable/custom/cyclic data rejected.
